```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)

rhinovirus <- read_csv("data/ukhsa-chart-download-rhinovirus.csv")
gt(head(rhinovirus))
```


```{r}
ggplot(rhinovirus, aes(
  x = date, 
  y = metric_value
)) +
geom_line( colour = "blue")+
xlab("date") +
ylab("disease (no. of cases)")+
ggtitle("respiratory disease number by date")

```
